resources.title: Adam Clarke Bible Commentary

description.fr: Commentaire méthodiste couvrant l’ensemble de la Bible, attentif au vocabulaire, aux langues anciennes et au contexte historique. Clarke associe explication du texte, discussion philologique et applications théologiques.
description.en: A Methodist commentary covering the whole Bible, with close attention to vocabulary, ancient languages, and historical context. Clarke combines textual explanation, philological discussion, and theological application.

resources.author: Adam Clarke
resources.source: Bible Strong Firestore ; comparaison prévue avec CrossWire Clarke

resources.title: Barnes’ Notes on the Bible

description.fr: Commentaire explicatif du XIXe siècle, rédigé pour accompagner une lecture suivie et accessible du texte biblique. Ses développements peuvent couvrir plusieurs versets et combinent contexte, argumentation et application pastorale.
description.en: A nineteenth-century explanatory commentary written to support a continuous and accessible reading of Scripture. Its discussions may span several verses and combine context, argument, and pastoral application.

resources.author: Albert Barnes
resources.coverage: Corpus Bible Strong ; module CrossWire officiel limité au Nouveau Testament
resources.source: Bible Strong Firestore ; CrossWire Barnes pour la provenance anglaise

resources.title: Commentaire concis de Matthew Henry

description.fr: Édition française du commentaire concis de Matthew Henry, organisée principalement par groupes de versets. Elle propose une lecture réformée, pastorale et pratique, centrée sur le sens spirituel et l’application du passage.

resources.author: Matthew Henry
resources.coverage: 66 livres, 4 145 unités par chapitre et plage
resources.rights: © Éditions CLÉ / Dominique Osché · tous droits réservés
resources.source: Fichier MHY.zip transmis à Bible Strong en novembre 2019

description.en: A condensed English edition of Matthew Henry’s work, structured by chapters and verse ranges. It summarizes interpretation, spiritual teaching, and practical application in a substantially shorter form than the complete commentary.

resources.title: Tyndale Open Study Notes

description.fr: Notes d’étude évangéliques contemporaines disponibles ici en anglais et en français. Elles expliquent le contexte littéraire et historique, les notions importantes et les liens entre passages dans un langage destiné à un large public.
description.en: Contemporary evangelical study notes available here in English and French. They explain literary and historical context, important concepts, and connections between passages in language intended for a broad readership.

resources.author: Tyndale House Publishers
resources.coverage: 66 livres, 16 923 unités disponibles en anglais et en français
resources.rights: © Mission Mutual / Tyndale House Publishers · CC BY-SA 4.0

resources.title: Jamieson–Fausset–Brown Commentary

description.en: A classic Protestant commentary designed as a compact reference for the whole Bible. It brings together exegetical, historical, and doctrinal observations, often organized around sections spanning several verses.

resources.author: R. Jamieson, A. R. Fausset, D. Brown

resources.title: Commentaires de saint Augustin

description.fr: Ensemble français de traités, exposés et homélies d’Augustin liés à des passages bibliques. Ces textes relèvent davantage de la lecture théologique et pastorale d’une œuvre patristique que d’un commentaire systématique verset par verset.

resources.author: Augustin d’Hippone
resources.coverage: Partielle, 1 726 unités sur canon protestant et deutérocanoniques présents

description.fr: Collection française d’homélies et d’expositions de Jean Chrysostome sur une sélection de livres bibliques. L’explication suit le mouvement du discours et développe largement les dimensions morales, pastorales et théologiques du passage.

resources.title: Rashi on Tanakh

description.en: A classic Jewish commentary on the Tanakh presented as concise glosses, sometimes with several comments on one verse. Rashi illuminates the language of the text while combining plain-sense reading, rabbinic tradition, and midrashic interpretation.

resources.author: Rachi
resources.rights: Metsudah Publications / Judaica Press · CC BY

description.en: John Calvin’s commentaries on a broad selection of biblical books, presented in a historical English edition. The work follows the argument of the text and combines exegesis, Reformed theology, and pastoral concerns.

resources.title: Keil & Delitzsch Commentary

description.en: A scholarly nineteenth-century commentary devoted to the Old Testament. Keil and Delitzsch give sustained attention to Hebrew, grammar, historical context, and the literary progression of extended sections.

resources.author: C. F. Keil et F. Delitzsch
resources.source: CrossWire KD 2.0, Wikisource et module BibleWorks documenté

description.en: John Wesley’s concise notes on the whole Bible, written to accompany ordinary reading of Scripture. They favor brief doctrinal and practical explanation within the Methodist and Arminian traditions.

Charles Spurgeon’s extensive exposition of the Psalms, combining commentary, quotations from earlier writers, and material for preaching. Each unit addresses an entire psalm rather than only the first verse where it is anchored.

A chain of patristic commentary on the four Gospels compiled by Thomas Aquinas. Each section assembles excerpts from Church Fathers, allowing several ancient interpretations to speak alongside one another on the same passage.

resources.title: Illustrated New Testament

description.en: A narrative and explanatory New Testament commentary written for accessible reading. The Abbott brothers develop the setting, characters, and teaching of the text in units that are generally concise.

resources.author: John S. C. Abbott et Jacob Abbott

description.en: An Anglican exposition of the New Testament organized by passage. Burkitt combines textual explanation, doctrinal summaries, and practical lessons in the pastoral style of the early eighteenth century.

resources.title: Darby Translation Notes

description.en: Notes associated with John Nelson Darby’s Bible translation rather than a continuous commentary on every passage. They primarily record translation choices, variants, lexical clarifications, and occasional observations on the text.

resources.author: John Nelson Darby
resources.coverage: Canon protestant et deutérocanoniques présents, 8 873 unités sur 1 251 chapitres

description.en: Concise Protestant notes designed for family study of the New Testament. They offer direct explanations, cross-references, and practical applications from an evangelical perspective.

resources.title: Geneva Bible Translation Notes

description.en: Marginal notes from the tradition of the Geneva Bible and the English-speaking Reformation. They provide translation clarifications, links between texts, and theological interpretations in a generally compressed form.

resources.author: Traducteurs de la Bible de Genève

resources.title: Kingcomments

description.en: A contemporary evangelical commentary covering the whole Bible and organized in chapter sections. Ger de Koning offers a continuous, practical, and theological reading shaped by the Brethren tradition.

resources.author: Ger de Koning
resources.rights: © Ger de Koning · tous droits réservés

resources.title: John Lightfoot Commentary

description.en: A selection of John Lightfoot’s commentary on the New Testament. The resource makes particular use of the author’s historical, linguistic, and rabbinic learning to illuminate the world behind the biblical text.

resources.author: John Lightfoot
resources.coverage: Couverture NT sélectionnée, 853 unités sur 91 chapitres

resources.title: Luther’s Commentary on Selected Bible Passages

description.en: An English collection of Martin Luther’s sermons and expositions on selected passages. Coverage is not continuous: units often follow a sermon or theological section extending beyond the verse used as their anchor.

resources.author: Martin Luther

resources.title: Matthew Henry’s Complete Commentary

description.en: The complete edition of Matthew Henry’s commentary, developed mainly at the level of chapters and their major sections. It combines Reformed exposition, spiritual meditation, and numerous pastoral applications.

resources.author: Matthew Henry
resources.coverage: 66 livres et introductions, 5 360 unités sur 1 194 chapitres

resources.title: Matthew Henry’s Modern English Commentary

description.en: STEPBible’s modern-English adaptation of Matthew Henry’s commentary. It preserves the organization and pastoral orientation of the original work while making its wording more accessible to present-day readers.

resources.author: Matthew Henry ; adaptation STEPBible
resources.source: STEPBible MHM, adaptation ChatGPT 4 de MHC réalisée en 2025

description.en: A New Testament commentary intended for personal study and teaching. B. W. Johnson combines verse-by-verse explanation, historical context, parallel references, and practical summaries.
A linguistic commentary on the New Testament grounded in Greek. A. T. Robertson explains words, grammatical forms, and textual expressions in order to bring out their nuances and vivid imagery.
Selective reference notes accompanying the 1917 Scofield edition. They connect passages, summarize major biblical themes, and present an explicitly dispensational interpretation.

resources.title: The Fourfold Gospel and Commentary on Acts

description.en: A harmonized commentary on the four Gospels, followed by an exposition of Acts. The authors bring parallel narratives together and comment on complete pericopes rather than treating each Gospel in isolation.

resources.author: J. W. McGarvey et Philip Y. Pendleton
resources.coverage: Évangiles et Actes, 4 229 unités sur 121 chapitres

resources.title: Original Douay–Rheims Annotations

description.en: Historical Catholic annotations published with the Douay–Rheims Bible and preserved according to the source JSON segmentation. They reflect the doctrinal and controversial reading of their period without reconstruction or supplementation by Bible Strong.

resources.author: Collège anglais de Douai–Reims
resources.coverage: 1 659 annotations JSON publiées, 390 chapitres et 53 livres avec contenu

resources.title: Bible Annotée de Neuchâtel

description.fr: Commentaire protestant francophone réalisé par une société de théologiens et de pasteurs. Il réunit introductions, analyses de sections et notes détaillées, avec une attention soutenue au contexte, à la langue et à l’interprétation du texte.

resources.author: Collectif Bonnet, Bovet, Godet et collaborateurs
resources.coverage: 66 livres, 23 320 unités : commentaires, 667 introductions de chapitre AT et 27 introductions de livre NT
resources.source: ThéoTeX, Bible Annotée AT et Nouveau Testament Annoté ; export intégral JSON du 28 août 2026

resources.title: Seventh-day Adventist Bible Commentary

description.en: A collaborative Seventh-day Adventist commentary covering all 66 books with introductions and detailed exegesis. This edition includes the general commentary and Ellen G. White supplements.
description.fr: Commentaire biblique adventiste collaboratif couvrant les 66 livres, avec introductions et exégèse détaillée. Cette édition comprend le commentaire général et les compléments d’Ellen G. White.

resources.author: Francis D. Nichol (dir.) et contributeurs
resources.coverage: 66 livres, 1 189 chapitres : 25 058 unités du commentaire général et des introductions, complétées par 3 664 extraits EGW
resources.rights: Review and Herald Publishing Association · tous droits réservés

description.en: Ellen G. White writings associated with Bible passages by the Complete Scripture Index. Each entry includes the indexed paragraphs, their book and section headings, Bible-reference links, and links back to the original context.

resources.author: Ellen G. White

resources.rights: Ellen G. White Estate · tous droits réservés
